title: Add course-scoped review mode to process command
description:
Problem: process --topic is the closest broad review scope but excludes raw notes/recordings/artifacts and includes sources from all courses, not just the target. Unsuitable for studying for a specific exam (e.g. want Data Structures scope without pulling in Introductory Java).

Proposed: --course {name} as a standalone process scope (distinct from its current session-disambiguator role):
- All sessions for that course → raw notes, recordings, artifacts included
- Sources filtered to that course via existing source_visible_for_course logic
- Other courses excluded

Design notes:
- Workspace assembly is straightforward; session scope already has per-course source filtering, this extends to N sessions
- Skill prompt needs a new mode header (Course Review) so the AI synthesizes across sessions rather than processing one session
- May need a new SkillVariant or a separate prompt branch in workspace.rs
- Flag name conflict: --course already exists as a disambiguator; options are (a) context-sensitive (no --session = scope mode), (b) rename new flag to --review, (c) rename disambiguator to --for-course

Open questions:
- What directive does the AI get with many sessions of raw notes? Consolidate? Gap-fill?
- Does this replace --topic for exam prep or complement it?
